summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 62 (Unified Node Codec Core Keystone) of the CipherBox project using the GSD workflow: research the domain, generate PLAN.md files for 9 plans across 7 waves, verify them, and execute all waves sequentially.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully (9 plans/7 waves, all gates passed, committed as 161bfade9). Execution ran through all 7 waves — Waves 1–6 are confirmed complete (8/9 plans done); Wave 7 (plan 62-08b, web component layer + final pnpm typecheck gate) was spawned but its result is not captured in the transcript.

repo: Phase 62 replaces legacy FolderMetadata/FileMetadata with a unified Node type using dual-sealed bodies (read + write) and generation-as-AAD; the blast radius is ~30 consumer files across core/sdk-core/sdk/web, all import-swap + stub.

Compile dependency chain is strictly ordered: core dist/ must be built before sdk-core typechecks, sdk-core dist/ before sdk, sdk dist/ before web — each wave rebuilds upstream dists before gating the consumer.
Consumer test files that import deleted types fail tsc before describe.skip evaluates; imports must be physically removed (not just test bodies skipped) to achieve a clean compile-gate.
Vault v3 blob layout: 0x03 | u16_BE(readLen) | ECIES(rootReadKey) | u16_BE(writeLen) | ECIES(rootWriteKey) — a two-key format replacing v2/v1; encryptedRootFolderKey removed entirely.

file-ipns.test.ts imported from ../file/derive-ipns and ../file/metadata (retired code), not from the live ipns/ module — deletion was correct. The live ipns/ tests (ipns.test.ts, ipns-record.test.ts) remained passing.
Core test count went 228→190 after cutover: −17 folder-metadata.test.ts + −21 file-ipns.test.ts, both importing only retired types.
Retired type names appearing in grep hits on core source files were migration comments only — zero live imports; tsc clean confirms this.
Nyquist validation requires a ## Validation Architecture section in RESEARCH.md before VALIDATION.md can be generated; omitting it leaves Dimension-8 requirements unspecified in plans.
workflow.auto_advance: true in config would normally chain straight into gsd-execute-phase after planning; --no-transition flag suppresses cross-phase chaining.
The gsd drift precheck flagged 143 pre-existing elements (stale Feb .learnings/, landing/, root configs) — the baseline map was simply old/missing, not a real regression.

code.finding: New unified Node, SealedChildRef, PublishedNode, content/write-body types replacing FolderMetadata and FileMetadata; fileKey stored as Uint8Array inside sealed read body.
sealNode/unsealNode compose Phase-61's sealAesGcmAad/buildNodeAad primitive; freeze-first design means this file must land before any consumer seals.
Barrel cutover: folder/ and file/ exports dropped, node/ exported. Seven files in folder/ and file/ deleted outright.
Frozen golden vectors using fixed node_id and IV from Phase-61 so Phase-69 Rust test can slot in without regeneration.
Cross-language vault v3 blob vector committed to repo; originally planned as inline in the plan but moved to this path for D-04 compliance and Rust parity.
Adapted to compile against Node (not a DB/ORM schema file — schema-gate hook correctly skipped it; DB schema lives in apps/api, Phase 66 scope).
nodeRef field changed to nodeRef?: Node; behavioral logic stubbed to phase 65 with throw new Error('not implemented — phase 65').

workflow: Sequential execution on the main worktree was chosen over parallel worktrees for a pnpm monorepo: worktrees lack node_modules and require per-worktree pnpm install, which is slow and complicates the cross-package dist chain.
The gsd commit helper reliably reports commit_failed as a false-negative — git log is the authoritative check; do not retry commits based on the helper's exit status alone.

Plan checker iteration 1 caught: RESEARCH.md missing (RESOLVED) markers (blocker), vault v3 vector placed inline instead of tests/vectors/ (warning), partial-tsc exit codes masked by trailing echo (warning), Plan 08 at ~43 files above split threshold (warning), web quarantine survey covering only 2 hardcoded test files instead of grep-discovery (warning).
Splitting an oversized plan (08→08a/08b) at planning time de-risks autonomous execution from context exhaustion on a large mechanical sweep.

Pattern mapper found 13/14 analogs: folder/metadata.ts codec, crypto/seal.ts primitive, vault/blob.ts v3, vault-blob-vectors.test.ts golden vectors — these become the executor's primary reference files.
The schema-gate hook (ORM scanner) correctly self-suppressed for a crypto codec phase; it only injects a push task when Prisma/Drizzle/TypeORM/Payload/Supabase schema files are in scope.
API-surface intel hook regenerated successfully but extracted 0 symbols (HINT-only file); omitting it from the planner prompt avoids injecting empty context.
PATTERNS.md is not committed by the planner's step 13d — it must be committed explicitly after the pattern-mapper subagent returns.

friction: gsd commit helper returns commit_failed even on successful commits (known false-negative); requires a follow-up git log to confirm landing.
gsd query commit also returns false-negatives mid-execution — executor had to independently verify commit landing.
Node eval for worktree-mode extraction had a quoting bug and had to be rerun.
Requirements-coverage display glitch: word-splitting caused all six NODE IDs to print as a single token, requiring a clean rerun to produce a valid result.

Drift precheck produced noisy output flagging 143 pre-existing elements due to a stale/missing codebase map baseline — non-blocking but required manual diagnosis to confirm it was not a real regression.
Plan checker required one full revision round (1 blocker + 4 warnings) before passing, adding a subagent round-trip to the planning phase.
open_items: Plan 62-08b (web component layer + authoritative root pnpm typecheck D-02 gate) was spawned but its result is not in the transcript — completion status unknown.

~30 consumer stub files across sdk-core, sdk, and web have throw new Error('not implemented — phase NN') placeholders; behavioral implementations deferred to Phase 65 (write-chain/share/bin/invite), Phase 66 (DB schema/apps/api), and others.
Phase 69: Rust-side golden vector test integration — frozen vectors use Phase-61 node_id/IV specifically to allow this slot-in, but Phase 69 has not run yet.
Codebase map is stale (baseline missing/old); /gsd-map-codebase was recommended but not run — drift precheck will continue producing noisy output until refreshed.
55 sdk-core tests and additional sdk/web suites are quarantined (describe.skip) pending behavioral restoration in their owning phases.
auto_advance: true remains in config — future plan-phase runs will auto-chain into execute-phase unless --no-transition is explicitly passed.
